contexts.text: The Lord's life... with such a man is perverted...
All truth is then not only perverted, but abolished.
The man who is in... cupidity perverts good; but still life thence remains. Explained.
Evil Spirits do not combat by reasoning... But they pervert goods and truths... AC 1820:4, Explained.
Then the influx of celestial love from the Lord is continually... perverted. Explained.
When natural things... pervert worship...
When the goods and truths of faith are perverted through natural lumen...
Extinguish, suffocate, or pervert...
To offer violence to truth is to pervert the things of faith; which are perverted when they are separated from charity...
Those who... pervert the life of the love of His good and truth into the loves of evil and falsity...
Reflect, pervert, or suffocate. AC 3147:2. AC 4214:3, Explained. AC 5032:3. AC 5127:end.
To lie with = to be perverted, or adulterated.
To pervert and adulterate truth. Signified, Explained.
The first state of the perversion of the Church. Signified, Explained.
The second state of the perversion of the Church. Signified, Explained.
The Church perverted. Treated of.
The greatest degree of the perversion... of the Church... which is profanation. Signified.
The Rational (thus) made perverted. Signified.
The light of Heaven... is perverted, as when the light of the sun inflows into foul objects.
Removed the upright... by perverting their counsels...
To hatch doctrinals from truths which they pervert. Signified.
That they perverted (charity). Signified.
To commit adultery = to pervert or adulterate goods.
The light of Heaven... is either rejected, suffocated, or perverted...
The scientifics which pervert, Signified.
Magic was nothing else than a perversion, and a perverted application of the things of order.
Separation from perverted scientifics. Signified, Explained.
Unless the internal and external man are conjoined, all the good inflowing... is either perverted, suffocated, or rejected.
Celestial love continually inflows... but in its progress it is perverted by the man; whence comes infernal love.
They thus not only defile, but also pervert, genuine mutual love...
The opposite conatus... is nothing else than the perversion into evil of the good which proceeds from the Lord.
The things of a perverted understanding; thus falsities. Signified.
With the evil, this influx... is resisted and rejected, or perverted, or suffocated...
In Hell... the Lord's influx through Heaven is... rejected, extinguished, or perverted.

Had open communication with evil Spirits, who had perverted all the truths of the Church... Hence magic... By their hieroglyphics they signified spiritual things, and perverted Divine order. Magic is nothing else than a perversion of order... Explained.
By general scientifics... the things of faith are perverted.
The cupidities of evil pervert not only truths, but goods.
Sorcerers = those who pervert Divine order.
To appearance they did the like by perverting the ends of order. Signified.
Such dullness is induced (there)... by the abuse and perversion of order. Explained.
When one in the affection of falsity applies truths to himself, he perverts and falsifies them. Explained.
The good and truth which inflow from the Lord are with them either rejected, extinguished, or perverted.
With those with whom they are perverted, the good of love and the truth of faith are wrongly explained, and are applied in favour of evil and thence of falsity.
The Egyptians perverted all truths and goods through applications to evil uses.
An evil man vastates himself... by extinguishing, rejecting, or perverting truth Divine...
Truths are falsified by wrong interpretations, and thus perversions.
If Genii were to inflow... they would pervert the affections of truth and good...
Gain = all falsity from evil, which perverts the judgments of the mind.
The perversion of the truth of the Church, and its restoration. Treated of.
That the things of the doctrine of faith and of charity are not to be perverted. Signified, Explained.
That which perverts good or truth in the Natural. Signified, Explained.
Amendment by truth is possible with perverted goods and truths, but not with extinguished ones.
The case is this: If good or truth is being perverted through falsity, that which is perverted is to be amended through truth... Explained, Signified.
To pervert () = to turn truth into falsity, and good into evil; and the reverse.
Perverts the words of the just () = that they appear as the truths of good.
When (truths and goods) are falsified and perverted, the man sickens; but, when they are denied at heart, he dies.
The things of abortion and barrenness are perversions of good and truth...
To pervert truths and goods... Signified.
To pervert the scientifics of truth and good from the sense of the letter... to favour their own cupidities, and still to worship them as holy... Signified.
To scortate = to pervert truths by applications to falsities or evils.
Animals could not pervert...
Man had perverted Divine order with himself...
After the confirmations he either perverts, suffocates, or reflects goods and truths...
That if man saw the Divine Providence... he would pervert and destroy it. General article.
If man knew all the operations of the brains into the fibres... would he not pervert... them? (So with all the other internal things of his body.)
Even those are perverted (in the World of Spirits) who have been devoted to piety.
The two sights... as to their perverted states. Compared.
If these three loves are not rightly subordinated, they pervert and invert man. TCR 403, General article.
In how subtle a manner he could pervert my thoughts. SE 1824.
The cunning of the devil in perverting truths and goods... Explained.
[Evils the perversion of what is good.]. Described.
Those... who study only those things which serve for the perversion of man. General article.
She perverted the vessels...
The methods of perversion and inversion cannot be described, because they are in the spiritual sphere.
He could turn and pervert, not only the affections, but also the thoughts and their affections.
The perversion of the Church through falsity... and its perversion through evil. Signified.
The spiritual life is extinguished through perversions of good and falsifications of truth.
